name: Cam-profile indication
summary: A cam-profile indication describes the mechanical profile associated with an operating sequence.
description: A cam-profile indication describes the mechanical profile associated with an operating sequence. A profile representation helps describe how a mechanical operating surface relates to the movement it produces. In an electrical diagram its purpose is the operating relationship rather than manufacturing geometry.
Use position or sequence references to link the profile to the operated contacts. Dimensions and machining detail belong in the relevant mechanical documentation.
readingNotes: Keep profile and position annotations consistent with the operated contacts.
A profile indication is not a manufacturing drawing of the physical cam.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Keep profile and position annotations consistent with the operated contacts.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A profile indication is not a manufacturing drawing of the physical cam.
